# resume-reverse-engineering

Copy this folder into your existing 4.0 package:

```text
copilot-home/
└── .github/skills/
    └── resume-reverse-engineering/
        └── SKILL.md
```

Then in a fresh Copilot session:

```text
/agent
→ system-reverse-engineer
```

Run:

```text
Use /resume-reverse-engineering.
```

Or resume and immediately continue a task:

```text
Use /resume-reverse-engineering,
then use /patch-impact-review for patch/abc.diff.
```
